# Glossary

This page lists the terms that the AlsoAsked API documentation uses, with the meaning of each term.

| Term | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| account | Your AlsoAsked account. The API keys, credits, and plan belong to it. | The response contains the credits in your account. |
| AI overview | An answer that Google generates from more than one web page. | If `ai_overview` is `true`, the answer is an AI overview. |
| AlsoAsked API | The HTTP API that you use to create searches and get results. | The AlsoAsked API accepts JSON request bodies. |
| API key | The secret value that identifies your account in each request. It starts with `aa-live-` or `aa-sandbox-`. | Create an API key on the API keys page. |
| asynchronous search | A search where the API sends the response immediately, before the search is complete. Set `async` to `true`. | An asynchronous search returns the search ID immediately. |
| body | The JSON content of a request or response. | The response body contains the search. |
| cached result | A result that AlsoAsked got from a previous search, not from Google at the time of your search. Set `fresh` to `true` to get new results. | Set `fresh` to `true` if you don't want cached results. |
| child result | A result inside another result. The result that contains it is its parent result. | The `results` field of a result contains its child results. |
| credit | The unit that AlsoAsked uses to charge for searches. A search costs credits for each term. The cost depends on the depth. | The cost of a search depends on the number of terms and the depth. |
| delete | To remove access to a search and its results with the `DELETE /v1.1/search/{searchId}` endpoint. | Delete the search when you don't need it. |
| depth | The number of levels of results that a search gets. The value is 1, 2, or 3. | Set the `depth` field to `3` to get 3 levels of results. |
| endpoint | One HTTP method and path of the AlsoAsked API, for example `POST /v1.1/search`. | Send the request to the `GET /v1.1/account` endpoint. |
| field | A name and value in a JSON object, for example `"depth": 2`. | Set the `depth` field to `3`. |
| get | To read data from the AlsoAsked API with a `GET` request. | Get the search with the `GET /v1.1/search/{searchId}` endpoint. |
| header | A name and value in the HTTP headers of a request or response. | Put your API key in the `X-Api-Key` header. |
| language code | The code of the language for a search, for example `en`. | The default language code is `en`. |
| live API | The AlsoAsked API that gets real results from Google and uses credits. Its host is `alsoaskedapi.com`. | You need a Pro plan to use the live API. |
| parameter | A value in the path or the query string of a request URL. | Use the `page` query parameter to get the next page. |
| perform | To start a new search with the `POST /v1.1/search` endpoint. Use it only with `search`. | Perform a search with the terms that you want results for. |
| plan | The AlsoAsked subscription level of an account, for example Pro. | You need a Pro plan to use the live API. |
| query | One item in the `queries` field of a search. A query contains one term and the results for that term. | The `queries` field contains one query for each term in the search. |
| rate limit | The maximum number of requests that you can send in a time window. | If you send more requests than the rate limit allows, the API returns the status code `429`. |
| region code | The two-letter ISO 3166-1 code of the country for a search, for example `us`. | The default region code is `us`. |
| request | An HTTP message that you send to an endpoint. Use it only in this sense. | Each request must include the `X-Api-Key` header. |
| response | The HTTP message that the AlsoAsked API returns for a request. | The response has the status code `200 OK`. |
| result | One question that Google shows for a term. A result has an answer and can have child results. | Each result has a `question` field and an `answer_excerpt` field. |
| return | What the AlsoAsked API does with a response. | The API returns the status code `404` if the search doesn't exist. |
| sandbox API | The AlsoAsked API for testing. It returns test results and uses separate sandbox credits, not the credits of your plan. Its host is `sandbox.alsoaskedapi.com`. | Use the sandbox API while you develop your integration. |
| search | A set of one or more terms that you send to the AlsoAsked API in one request. Each search has an ID, a status, and a depth. | The search has 3 terms and a depth of 2. |
| send | To transmit a request (you) or a webhook event (AlsoAsked). | Send a request to the `GET /v1.1/account` endpoint. |
| signature | The value in the `X-AlsoAsked-Signature` header that shows that AlsoAsked sent the webhook event. | Verify the signature before you use the body. |
| status | The stage of a search or of one of its terms: `queueing`, `pending`, `running`, `fetching`, `error`, `no_results` or `success`. | When the status of a query is `success`, the `results` field of the query contains the results. |
| status code | The three-digit number in an HTTP response that shows the result of the request, for example `429`. | The status code `429` tells you that you sent too many requests. |
| synchronous search | A search where the API sends the response only when the search is complete, or after 90 seconds. Set `async` to `false`. | A synchronous search returns the results in the response body. |
| term | A question or phrase that AlsoAsked searches for. A search has 1 to 1,000 terms. | Put each term in the `terms` field. |
| top-level result | A result that isn't inside another result. Its `position` field has one number. | A search with a depth of 1 gets only top-level results. |
| verify | To make sure that a signature is correct. | Verify the signature of each webhook event. |
| webhook endpoint | A URL on your server that receives webhook events from AlsoAsked. Always write both words. | Add a webhook endpoint on the Webhook Endpoints page. |
| webhook event | A request that AlsoAsked sends to your webhook endpoints when the status of a search changes, for example `search_succeeded`. | AlsoAsked sends a `search_started` webhook event when the search starts. |
| webhook signing key | The secret value that AlsoAsked uses to make the signature of each webhook event. | Use your webhook signing key to verify the signature. |
